fact: In March 1974, OAPEC lifted the embargo, but the price of oil had risen by nearly 300%: from US$3/barrel to nearly US$12/barrel globally.
second: Sadat liked to say that his favourite game was backgammon, making an analogy between how he played backgammon and conducted his diplomacy.
